title: Testing with Vitest and React Testing Library

videos.script:
Every check so far has been somebody looking. Today the planner gets checks that run again on every change, and say in one line whether it still works.

{{setup}} First Vitest, which reads the same Vite configuration as the app, and Testing Library, which finds things the way a person does. One setup file, and an empty page between tests.

{{function}} Then the simplest test: the date arithmetic, at its edges.

{{component}} Then the promise from lesson one: a test that the week says eighty of a hundred and ninety-five minutes. And the same test failing on purpose, so that you know how to read a failure.

{{user}} And last, what a person does: a click that asks for next week, and a form that refuses an empty date and sends a typed one, with a fake planner in its context.
